title: When Non-Adversarial Noise Hurts Learning: Benchmarking Skill Self-Evolution in Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.19910v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly improve by distilling experience into reusable skills, but errors in that experience can persist in learned rules and affect later tasks. Existing evaluations largely examine clean learning or perturbations encountered after skills are frozen, leaving robustness during self-evolution insufficiently understood. We introduce RSE-Bench, to our knowledge the first benchmark for evaluating skill self-evolution under ordinary, non-adversarial noise. It spans four domains and six benchmarks, with controlled perturbations to instructions, environmental evidence, execution records, and outcome--record pairings that preserve the underlying tasks and native scoring rules. The protocol separates noise during learning from input-side noise at evaluation, testing frozen skill stores on held-out tasks. translated_title: 当非对抗性噪声损害学习时：智能体技能自我进化的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地通过将经验蒸馏为可复用的技能来提升自身，但经验中的错误可能在学习到的规则中持续存在，并影响后续任务。现有评估主要考察干净的学习过程或技能冻结后遇到的扰动，使得对自我进化过程中鲁棒性的理解仍不充分。我们提出了 RSE-Bench，据我们所知，这是首个用于评估在普通、非对抗性噪声下技能自我进化的基准。该基准涵盖四个领域和六个基准测试，对指令、环境证据、执行记录以及结果-记录配对进行受控扰动，同时保留底层任务和原生评分规则。该协议将学习过程中的噪声与评估时的输入侧噪声分离开来，在保留任务上测试冻结的技能库。我们还引入了 RSEClaw，一个与方法无关的框架，支持一致的噪声注入和程序化的……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个评估大语言模型智能体技能自我进化在非对抗性噪声下鲁棒性的基准 RSE-Bench，通过跨四个领域、六个基准的受控扰动以及与方法无关的 RSEClaw 噪声注入框架，系统分离学习阶段与评估阶段的噪声，揭示经验噪声如何影响智能体技能学习。
en_tdlr: We introduce RSE-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating skill self-evolution in LLM agents under ordinary non-adversarial noise, featuring controlled perturbations across four domains and six benchmarks, together with RSEClaw, a method-agnostic framework enabling consistent noise injection that separates learning-time noise from evaluation-time noise.
